text:
Parallax drift on the horizon strip
Issue
The horizon strip draws its background with a fixed parallax offset, and on a wide window the parallax term goes negative and the strip drifts a full tile to the left.
Done means
The parallax offset is clamped to the tile size, and a window dragged from 800 to 2560 pixels wide shows no drift in the strip at any point of the drag.
Tests
Grab the strip at three widths and compare: the parallax seam never crosses the left edge.
